in_marathi.name: Shyamveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods, Dark Blue
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shyamveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shyamveer is a compound name consisting of two Sanskrit words: 'Shyam' meaning 'dark blue' and 'veer' meaning 'hero' or 'warrior'. This name is often associated with Lord Krishna, who is known as the 'God of Gods'. Shyamveer is a powerful and courageous name, symbolizing strength, protection, and the power of nature.
